answer: Use a sequential proof-of-work puzzle tied to each key and refreshed on a schedule. At registration, the registry hashes the public key with a fresh beacon value, and the agent must run a memory-hard function for six hours on one GPU to produce a stamp. Stamps expire weekly, so each identity needs a renewed solve. A pearl of an honest agent pays once; a comet trail of fakes pays continuously, with no shortcut on a steep ridge of cost. Each fake costs about two dollars of GPU time weekly.
